en: An |Efficient| ability refunds 1 |CORE POWER| at the end of any scene in which it was used, so it is available again in the next one.

Barely larger than the cannon bolted through it, the Fitzgerald is what happens when a shipyard is asked for artillery and answers with a recoil problem. Its gunners do not need to see what they are shooting at, and its chassis does not expect to survive doing so.
The Fitzgerald receives |+1 Difficulty| on all SYSTEMS saves and checks.

The BIZARRE CANNON is built through the Fitzgerald's chassis rather than mounted on it: it occupies no weapon mount and cannot take a weapon mod. Its active MORE BLACK POWDER protocol grants the cannon a second profile.
On attack: you take 2 |AP| kinetic damage and are knocked back 2 spaces, away from the direction of fire.

For the rest of this scene, the BIZARRE CANNON gains a second profile: Heavy Cannon, |AP|, |Reliable 3|, |Heat 1| (Self). [|Line 15|] [2d6 kinetic + 1d6 explosive damage]. The original profile remains available.
On attack: you take 3 |AP| kinetic damage and are knocked back 3 spaces, in any direction. On hit: targets must succeed on a |hull save| or become |prone|.
The BIZARRE CANNON has a second, heavier profile for the rest of this scene.
The Fitzgerald may ignore line of sight when attacking with |cannon| or |Line| weapons. Targets attacked this way have |soft cover|.
Attacked without being seen: the shot treats this target as having soft cover.
1/round, when the Fitzgerald critically hits a character with a |cannon|, that character must succeed on a |hull save| or be knocked |Prone|.
|Loading| (3 rounds). The gun holds three rounds and is reloaded as a whole: every profile draws on the same three, and when the last one is spent the gun is empty until it is reloaded.
Fire one of the gun's three rounds.

Fire all three of the gun's rounds at once in a |Line 10|, |Reliable 3|, |Heat 2| (Self). On a hit, the target must succeed on a |hull save| or become |Shredded| until the end of their next turn. Requires all three rounds.

|Limited| 3, |Unique|. Whenever you destroy a hostile character or deployable with a |rifle|, |launcher| or |cannon| you may expend a charge to make them explode violently. All characters within |Burst 1| of the destroyed character or deployable must succeed on an |agility save| or take 1d6+1 |AP| kinetic damage.

1/round, when the Fitzgerald makes a successful ranged attack with a |Line| weapon, it deals additional bonus damage to each character hit after the first: +1 to the second, +2 to the third, and so on down the line.
|Limited| 3, |Unique|. Thrusters bolted along the spine, meant for shifting cargo hulls and used here to shift the Fitzgerald.

Expend a charge: fly your |Speed| in a straight line in any direction, moving through hostile characters. Every hostile character you pass through or become adjacent to during this movement must succeed on a |hull save| or be knocked |Prone| and take 3 |AP| kinetic damage. For each occupied space you pass through, you take 1 |AP| kinetic damage. This movement ignores |engagement| and does not provoke reactions.
This weapon deals +1d6 bonus damage against targets with at least 1 Armor. Attacks made with this weapon lose |AP| and cannot gain |AP| by any means.
A short, wide-bore gun bolted through the Fitzgerald's flank. It fires a solid shot straight down its own barrel line, and it does not much care what is standing in the way of it.

Main Cannon, |AP|, |Heat 2| (Self). |Line 8|, 1d6+1 kinetic. This attack ignores cover, and deals 10 |AP| kinetic damage to all objects and terrain within the line, destroying any breakable interior walls in its path outright.
|Limited| 3, |Unique|. Salvaged hull-plate magnets, flung out on a spread charge and slapped flat against whatever they land on.
Spend a charge and choose a |Blast 1| area within |Sensors|. All characters within the area gain 1 armor until the end of your next turn.
Plated in grit latch magnets: 1 armor until the end of the Fitzgerald's next turn.
